name: run_compute_job
title: Run a compute job on GitHub Actions
description: Start a `computeJobs` job on GitHub Actions, on a commit on the remote default branch. Answers with the run; follow with get_compute_job. A going or live-artifact run of the same commit is returned unless `force`. Costs minutes. Cloud-deploy and engine-release are owner-only (release_owner_only).

job.description: The job name in the repository settings.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit id; it must be on the remote default branch.

repo.description: The repository name in the project; default: the only repository (required with several).

force.description: Start a new run even if the commit has a live run or artifact already (default false).

task_key.description: A card of this project that gets a note when the run ends.

annotations.title: Run a compute job on GitHub Actions
